title: Translation-Haar reduction to stationary positive-amplitude densities

haar_reduction.setting: Finite cutoff Q_N over the normalized spatial torus, with mu_N=N(0,I), positive Omega_N, orthogonal translations U_a commuting with Omega_N, and normalized finite-Fisher states of finite full energy.
haar_reduction.phase: q_0[sqrt(rho) exp(i theta)]=(1/4)I_Omega(rho|mu_N)+int |grad theta|_Omega^2 rho dmu_N, so phase removal cannot increase energy.
haar_reduction.average: rho_a(q)=rho(U_a^(-1)q) and bar rho=int_(T^3)rho_a da is normalized and stationary.
haar_reduction.fisher: Convexity of the perspective (p,v)->v^T Omega_N v/p and Haar invariance give I_Omega(bar rho|mu_N)<=I_Omega(rho|mu_N).
haar_reduction.potential: Translation invariance of the finite-cutoff Wick-square potential gives int W_N bar rho dmu_N=int W_N rho dmu_N exactly.
haar_reduction.conclusion: At every finite cutoff, the unrestricted finite-full-energy infimum equals the infimum over stationary positive-amplitude finite-full-energy finite-Fisher densities.
haar_reduction.scope_guard: This is a finite-cutoff reduction; it neither constructs an infinite-cutoff minimizer nor supplies a source-owned physical state.
